draft.title: The external environment
card: The external environment is everything outside a business that it cannot control but must respond to. It can bring both opportunities and threats.
forces that affect all businesses, such as the economy, laws, technology and changes in society.
the forces that a business deals with directly, which are its customers, suppliers and competitors. It is also called the operating environment.
A business can try to influence its market environment, for example by advertising to customers. It cannot control the general environment, so it must adapt to it.
draft.remember: The external environment is outside the business's control: the general environment hits everyone, the market environment is its own customers, suppliers and competitors.

a.q: Which of these is part of a business's market environment?
opts: A rival bakery that opens across the road
A new law on workplace safety
A rise in the age of the population
A fall in the value of the Australian dollar
a.why: A competitor is one of the groups a business deals with directly, so it belongs to the market environment. The other three affect all businesses, so they are part of the general environment.
a.clue: Which one is a group the business deals with directly?

b.q: Priya runs a bike shop in Orange. A new law raises safety standards for all bike helmets sold in Australia. Which statement is correct?
opts: It is a general environment force that Priya must respond to
It is a market environment force that Priya can control
It is an internal force because it changes her stock
It is a market force because it affects her customers
b.why: A law applies to all businesses selling helmets and is outside Priya's control, so it is part of the general environment. It does change her stock and affect customers, but that does not make it a market force or an internal one.
b.clue: Does the law come from a customer, supplier or competitor, or does it apply to everyone?

a.best: A rival bakery that opens across the road

b.best: It is a general environment force that Priya must respond to
